uint8_t *ppt_get_tx_buffer(uint16_t payload_len)

Get the tx buffer used by the DMA for sending data.

The RAM type used by the DMA is limited to a specific buffer RAM type. This driver manages the memory for easy use at the application.

Parameters:

payload_len -- [in] Length of the payload.

Returns:

Pointer of the buffer.

uint8_t *ppt_get_tx_buffer_by_entry(uint8_t entry, uint16_t payload_len)

Get the tx buffer used by the DMA for sending data of designated channel.

The RAM type used by the DMA is limited to a specific buffer RAM type. This driver manages the memory for easy use at the application.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • payload_len -- [in] Length of the payload.

Returns:

Pointer of the buffer.

uint8_t *ppt_get_rx_buffer(uint16_t pdu_len)

Get the rx buffer used by the DMA for receiving data.

The RAM type used by DMA is limited to a specific buffer RAM type. This driver manages the memory for easy use at the application.

Parameters:

pdu_len -- [in] Length of the header and the payload.

Returns:

Pointer of the buffer.

void ppt_push_tx_data(uint16_t len, uint8_t *data)

Push and copy the data to the hw tx fifo of the channel 0.

The data will be copied, so the RAM type of the data can be any type.

Parameters:

  • len -- [in] Length of the payload.

  • data -- [in] Pointer of the payload.

void ppt_update_tx_data(uint16_t len, uint8_t *data)

Update and copy the data to the hw tx fifo of the channel 0.

The last pushed data can be updated by this function. The channel index is 0.

Parameters:

  • len -- [in] Length of the payload.

  • data -- [in] Pointer of the payload.

void ppt_push_tx_data_by_entry(uint8_t entry, uint16_t len, uint8_t *data)

Push and copy the data to the hw tx fifo of the specific channel.

The data will be copied, so the RAM type of the data can be any type.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • len -- [in] Length of the payload.

  • data -- [in] Pointer of the payload.

uint8_t *ppt_pop_rx_data(uint16_t len)

Pop and copy the data from the hw rx fifo of the channel 0.

The data will be copied to the buffer RAM whose pointer will be returned.

Parameters:

len -- [in] Length of the header and the payload.

Returns:

Pointer of the header and the payload.

uint8_t *ppt_pop_rx_data_by_entry(uint8_t entry, uint16_t len)

Pop and copy the data from the hw fifo of the specific channel.

The data will be copied to the buffer RAM whose pointer will be returned.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • len -- [in] Length of the header and the payload.

Returns:

Pointer of the header and the payload.

void ppt_async_cb_template(void)

Asynchronous callback template.

User can use this api for an asynchronous calling when there is no any operation at the asynchronous callback.

void ppt_enable_ptx(void (*async_cb)(void))

Enable ptx state.

If the callback is null, then the api returns after the procedure is done in a synchronous way. Otherwise, the caller will be notified via the callback when the procedure is done in an asynchronous way.

Parameters:

async_cb -- [in] Pointer of the asynchronous callback function.

void ppt_disable_ptx(void (*async_cb)(void))

Disable ptx state.

If the callback is null, then the API returns after the procedure is done in a synchronous way. Otherwise, the caller will be notified via the callback when the procedure is done in an asynchronous way.

Parameters:

async_cb -- [in] Pointer of the asynchronous callback function.

void ppt_enable_prx(void (*async_cb)(void))

Enable prx state.

If the callback is null, then the API returns after the procedure is done in a synchronous way. Otherwise, the caller will be notified via the callback when the procedure is done in an asynchronous way.

Parameters:

async_cb -- [in] Pointer of the asynchronous callback function.

void ppt_disable_prx(void (*async_cb)(void))

Disable prx state.

If the callback is null, then the API returns after the procedure is done in a synchronous way. Otherwise, the caller will be notified via the callback when the procedure is done in an asynchronous way.

Parameters:

async_cb -- [in] Pointer of the asynchronous callback function.

void ppt_reset_hw_fsm(void)

Reset the finite state machine of the hardware module.

The reset feature shall be enabled previously by fw_rst_enable flag in PRO_RESET_CTRL_REG. This API will generate a mac interrupt, so it shall be called in the critical section if at lower priority. All the internal states will be reset except for the interface registers Register Name & Address Offset.

bool ppt_kill_hw_fsm(ppt_fsm_t fsm)

Kill the finite state machine of the hardware module.

This API will generate a mac interrupt, so it shall be called in the critical section if at lower priority.

Parameters:

fsm -- [in] State to kill.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Current state of the hardware mismatches the input state.

Returns:

Result.

void ppt_enable_psd(void (*async_cb)(void))

Enable psd procedure.

If the callback is null, then the API returns after the procedure is done in a synchronous way. Otherwise, the caller will be notified via the callback when the procedure is done in an asynchronous way.

Example usage 

ppt_psd_mode_ext_t param =
{
    {
        .chann_start = 0,
        .chann_stop = 0,
        .chann_step = 1,
        .mode = 0,
        .timeout = PSD_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT
    }
};
ppt_set_psd_mode_ext(&param);
ppt_enable_psd(NULL);
int16_t rssi = ppt_get_psd_result(0);

Parameters:

async_cb -- [in] Pointer of the asynchronous callback function.

void ppt_disable_psd(void (*async_cb)(void))

Disable psd procedure.

If the callback is null, then the API returns after the procedure is done in a synchronous way. Otherwise, the caller will be notified via the callback when the procedure is done in an asynchronous way.

Parameters:

async_cb -- [in] Pointer of the asynchronous callback function.

int16_t ppt_get_psd_result(uint8_t chann)

Get the psd result.

Parameters:

chann -- [in] Channel index, shall be less than PSD_CHANN_NUM.

Returns:

Channel power spectrum density in dBm.

void ppt_clear_psd_result(void)

Clear the psd results.
